He lost his business, then decided the story would not end there.

Kevin Trudeau says he decided to turn things around and be bigger than ever, even though he did not know how. He calls that the idea of a winner: facing a mountain and refusing to quit.

Within a few months he met someone who put him on TV, and a new way of sharing his work opened up, one nobody had even considered before.

What unexpected door opened for you after something fell apart?
